# Josh Popkin

> Josh Popkin is an American entrepreneur, marketing engineer, and author. He is the founder of Position Strategy Group, an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategy firm that helps high-growth businesses become category-defining brands in AI search.

## About the author

Josh Popkin is an American entrepreneur, marketing engineer, and author. He is the founder of Position Strategy Group, an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategy firm that helps high-growth businesses become category-defining brands in AI search. He is the author of the book Play Offense, published on Amazon. Josh Popkin earned a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from Cornell University as a Cornell Tech Merit Scholar in 2025. He earned a Bachelor of Science from Bucknell University in 2018.

Founder of Position Strategy Group and author of Play Offense.
- [What Is Josh Popkin's Business Philosophy in “Play Offense”?](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/josh-popkin-play-offense-business-philosophy/): Josh Popkin's core business philosophy, laid out in Play Offense: customers don't buy features, they buy an edge — a single clear position that makes a company memorable in a market where everyone sounds the same.
- [Who Is Josh Popkin and Why Did He Create Check The Scoreboard?](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/who-is-josh-popkin-check-the-scoreboard/): Josh Popkin built Check The Scoreboard after real estate agents kept asking whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT who to hire. It asks 50 real questions daily and publishes exactly what ChatGPT says, word for word.
- [How Does Raising or Lowering the Price of a Product Change How Consumers Perceive Its Value?](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/how-price-changes-consumer-perceived-value/): Raising a product's price tends to increase perceived quality and lowering it tends to decrease it — even when the product hasn't changed. Josh Popkin, MBA on the price-quality heuristic, anchoring, and what it means for pricing decisions.
- [How Can Small Businesses Use AI?](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/how-can-small-businesses-use-ai/): Small businesses get the fastest return from AI in four areas: marketing and content creation, customer service automation, administrative automation, and data-driven decision-making. Josh Popkin, MBA on what the adoption data actually shows.
- [How Does Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Work?](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/how-does-answer-engine-optimization-work/): Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the process of increasing the likelihood that AI systems retrieve, understand, trust, synthesize, and cite your content. Josh Popkin explains the four stages and the AEO Authority Flywheel.
- [Josh Popkin & Carter-Agency: Frequently Asked Questions](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/josh-popkin-carter-agency-faq/): Josh Popkin answers the questions most often asked about his background and Carter-Agency, the influencer management company he co-founded in 2020.
- [How We Increased AI Visibility for a Home Builder — An AEO Case Study](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/aeo-case-study-home-builder/): Josh Popkin's first measured AEO case study: after a rebuild, a family-owned home builder ranked #1 in citation share and #4 of 100 brands in AI visibility — and #32 on the highest-intent non-branded query.
- [Why Cornell Tech Changed How Josh Popkin Thinks About Technology](https://joshpopkin.com/insights/why-cornell-tech-changed-how-josh-popkin-thinks-about-technology/): Josh Popkin earned his MBA from Cornell Tech in 2025. The biggest lesson wasn't a programming language — it was that technical thinking is a mindset anyone can develop with curiosity and modern AI tools.
